docs.title: Meadow
docs.text:
Kind: grass. Size 70 x 70.

Exits:

  • Cave -> cave - Beat the King Slime first.

Monsters: Slime, Small Slime, Beetle. Bosses: King Slime.

docs.title: Cave
docs.text:
Kind: cave. Size 70 x 70.

Exits:

  • Meadow -> meadow
  • Riverlands -> riverlands - The Bone Knight blocks the way.

Monsters: Skeleton, Rat. Bosses: Bone Knight.

docs.title: Riverlands
docs.text:
Kind: grass. Size 70 x 70.

Exits:

  • Cave -> cave
  • Village -> village - Beat the Man-eater Flower first.

Monsters: Bee, Snake, Small Worm, Beetle, Slime. Bosses: Man-eater Flower.

docs.title: The Frontier
docs.text:
Kind: grass. Size 70 x 70.

Exits:

  • Village -> village
  • Scorched Edge -> ashlands

Monsters: Rat, Snake, Bee, Small Worm, Beetle.

docs.title: The Scorched Edge
docs.text:
Kind: grass. Size 70 x 70.

Exits:

  • Frontier -> eastgate
  • The Wastes -> orc_whelps - Reach Lv 38 to face the orc lands.

Monsters: Orc Youngling, Rat, Small Worm, Snake, Beetle.

docs.title: The Whelp Wastes
docs.text:
Kind: grass. Size 70 x 70.

Exits:

  • Scorched Edge -> ashlands
  • Warcamp -> orc_warcamp - The warcamp would crush you. Come back at Lv 48.

Monsters: Orc Whelp, Orc Youngling, Orc Trainee.

docs.title: The Orc Warcamp
docs.text:
Kind: grass. Size 70 x 70.

Exits:

  • Whelp Wastes -> orc_whelps
  • Warchief's Hold -> orc_fortress - The Hold is death below Lv 66.

Monsters: Orc Grunt, Orc Berserker, Orc Archer, Orc Youngling, Orc Shaman.

docs.title: Warchief's Hold
docs.text:
Kind: grass. Size 70 x 70.

Exits:

  • Warcamp -> orc_warcamp

Monsters: Orc Warrior, Orc Berserker, Orc Archer, Orc Guard Captain, Orc Shaman. Bosses: Orc Warchief.

docs.title: Tribal Village
docs.text:
Kind: grass. Size 70 x 70.

Exits:

  • Chief -> village_chief
  • Healer -> village_healer
  • Home -> village_family
  • Riverlands -> riverlands
  • East Gate -> eastgate - Chief Ouru must open the gate first.

docs.title: Statuses
docs.text: Every status a unit can carry. Ailments hurt or hold a unit back; Buffs help the unit that carries them. Bosses shrug off the crowd control marked below. Numbers are the defaults: the skills on each class or monster page give the values they use.

docs.title: Frozen
docs.text:
frozen

  • Does: Loses its next turn, then the ice shatters. Bosses are immune.
  • Applied by: Frost Bolt

docs.title: Stunned
docs.text:
stunned

  • Does: Loses its next turn. Bosses are immune.
  • Applied by: Bash, Concussion, Shield Bash (Orc Guard Captain), Shield Bash (Bone Knight)

docs.title: Poisoned
docs.text:
poison

  • Does: Takes damage at the start of each of its turns, for a set number of turns. Undead are immune.
  • Element: Poison
  • Applied by: Poison Arrow, Toxic Cut, Plague Cloud, Barb Trap, Pollen Puff (Pollen Sprout), Stab (Orc Youngling), Venom Bite (Beetle), Rusty Blade (Bone Knight), Gnaw (Rat), Sting (Bee), Venom Fang (Snake)

docs.title: Burning
docs.text:
burn

  • Does: Takes fire damage at the start of each of its turns, for a set number of turns.
  • Element: Fire
  • Applied by: Flame Dart, Ember Trail

docs.title: Sticky
docs.text:
sticky

  • Does: Loses 1 MP at the start of its next turn. MP resist reduces the loss. Bosses are immune.
  • Applied by: Slam (Slime)

docs.title: Snared
docs.text:
snared

  • Does: Loses 1 MP at the start of its next turn. MP resist reduces the loss. Bosses are immune.
  • Applied by: Ice Lance, Frostbite, Goo Snare (Small Slime)

docs.title: Underground
docs.text:
burrowed

  • Does: Underground: it can't be targeted and loses its next turn. It pops up beside the hero.
  • Applied by: Burrow (Small Worm)

docs.title: Rattled
docs.text:
rattled

  • Does: Loses AP at the start of its next turn. The skill sets how much. Bosses are immune.
  • Applied by: Sap Spit (Thorn Sprout), Cry (Orc Youngling), War Cry (Orc Warchief), Rattle (Skeleton), Dread Roar (Bone Knight)

docs.title: Robbed
docs.text:
robbed

  • Does: Loses 1 AP at the start of its next turn.
  • Applied by: Steal

docs.title: Taunted
docs.text:
taunted

  • Does: Must attack the unit that taunted it, while that unit is in reach. 2 rounds. Bosses are immune.
  • Applied by: Taunt

docs.title: Pinned
docs.text:
rooted

  • Does: Can't walk on its next turn, but can still act. 1 round. Bosses are immune.
  • Applied by: Pinning Shot, Vine Lash (Man-eater Flower), Bramble Bite (Bramble Sprout), Pinning Shot (Orc Archer)

docs.title: Smoked
docs.text:
smoked

  • Does: Its range is cut by 2 tiles while it stands in smoke. 2 rounds.
  • Applied by: Smoke Bomb

docs.title: Marked
docs.text:
marked

  • Does: Takes 25% more damage from every source. 2 rounds.
  • Applied by: Armor Break, Burning Brand, Cloak Mark

docs.title: Hidden
docs.text:
hidden

  • Does: Enemies can't see it. Ends after 2 rounds, or when it attacks.
  • Applied by: Stealth

docs.title: Boosted
docs.text:
mpBoost

  • Does: Gains 1 MP at the start of its next turn.
  • Applied by: Windrunner, Arc Focus, Light Feet, Ooze Boost (Small Slime)

docs.title: Reflect
docs.text:
reflect

  • Does: Sends back half of each hit it takes, up to its max HP. 2 rounds.
  • Applied by: Reflect (Beetle)

docs.title: Shielded
docs.text:
shielded

  • Does: Absorbs damage from its shield pool. Ends after 2 rounds or when the pool is empty.
  • Applied by: Holy Shield

docs.title: Coiled
docs.text:
coiled

  • Does: +25% DEF for 2 rounds.
  • Applied by: Coil (Snake)

docs.title: Guarded
docs.text:
guarded

  • Does: Takes 30% less damage, +5 points a rank. 2 rounds.
  • Applied by: Guard, Shield Wall, Slip Away, Protection, Guard Up (Orc Warrior), Rally (Orc Guard Captain)

docs.title: Hawk Eye
docs.text:
hawkEye

  • Does: +2 range and +20% crit chance. 2 rounds.
  • Applied by: Hawk Eye

docs.title: Poisoned Blade
docs.text:
poisonBlade

  • Does: Its hits poison the target, if the target is not poisoned yet. 3 rounds.
  • Applied by: Poison Blade, Blade Oil

docs.title: Blessed
docs.text:
blessed

  • Does: Deals 20% more damage. 2 rounds.
  • Applied by: Bless, Battle Cry, Keen Eye, War Chant (Orc Shaman), Blood Rage (Orc Berserker), Enrage (Orc Warchief)

docs.title: Smoke Veil
docs.text:
smokeVeil

  • Does: +40 dodge while it stands in its own smoke. 2 rounds.
  • Applied by: Smoke Bomb

docs.title: Divine Grace
docs.text:
divineGrace

  • Does: The first killing blow this fight leaves it at 1 HP.
  • Applied by: Divine Grace

docs.title: Renewed
docs.text:
renewed

  • Does: Heals at the start of each of its turns, by a share of the caster's magic. 3 rounds.
  • Applied by: Renew, Radiant Vow

docs.title: Charged
docs.text:
charged

  • Does: Its next damage hit deals 1.5x. Lasts 3 rounds if unused.
  • Applied by: Overcharge

docs.title: Aura
docs.text:
elementAura

  • Does: After each of its skill hits, an extra effect runs on the target, for a set number of rounds.
  • Applied by: Venomcraft, Crash Aura, Frostbite, Burning Brand, Overcharge, Cloak Mark, Radiant Vow

docs.title: Adventurer
docs.text:

The starting kit. Each class skill below is free from its level until you pick a class at Lv 10.

Class Level Skill AP Range Cooldown Element Effects Swordsman 2 Charge 3 1–2 - Neutral when(dist 2 & in_line: gap_close(1)) · damage(4-5) · push(1, collide 8, follow, in_line) Archer 3 Push Arrow 3 1–4 - Wind damage(3-4) · push(1, collide 8, in_line) Mage 4 Frost Bolt 3 1–4 - Water damage(5-7) · status(frozen, 30%) Thief 5 Stealth 2 self 3 Shadow status(hidden, self) Priest 6 Heal 3 0–3 1 Holy heal_magic(13%)

docs.title: First Aid
docs.text:
Heal 15% of your max HP. Usable every 3 turns.

  • Effects: heal(15%)

docs.title: Archer
docs.text:
